title: MoE中的知识注入？专家感知对比解码缓解LLM幻觉
summary: 针对LLM幻觉问题，提出EAACD方法，利用MoE模型高层专家的激活差异进行对比解码。将专家分为高可靠组和低可靠组，通过对比校准预测，并增强低可靠专家的幻觉信号作为负参考，在四个数据集上优于所有基线。
summary_en: Proposes EAACD, an expert-aware adaptive contrast decoding method for mitigating LLM hallucinations in MoE models. It leverages expert activation differences in higher layers, contrasting high-reliability and low-reliability expert groups to calibrate predictions, outperforming baselines on four datasets.
